items.text: Steelers downgraded Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs NE due to foot injury (from Q on ETR list).
items.why: Foot injury; LP-DNP-DNP practice trend led to downgrade.
items.implication: Remove Pittman from lineups; PIT WR volume redistributes (DK Metcalf/others).
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for remaining PIT receivers in pass game.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT/DOUBTFUL on ETR Sunday injury report for Week 2; hamstring injury confirmed OUT by Schefter/Rapoport. HOU WR room reduced to crumbs.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in practice; ruled out for Sunday vs CIN.
items.implication: Fade Collins; elevate HOU pass-catchers and TE Dalton Schultz for volume.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU WRs and Schultz in absence.

items.text: Zay Flowers and Ja'Kobi Lane OUT/DOUBTFUL on ETR list; Rapoport confirms Flowers doubtful vs Saints. BAL WR hierarchy shifts to Bateman/Walker/Wester.
items.why: Hamstring; second straight missed practice; Lane on IR/return with fractured wrist.
items.implication: Fade Flowers; target BAL WR crumbs and Andrews/Likely for elevated share.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman, Devontez Walker primary beneficiaries in target/route share.

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT/DOUBTFUL per ETR; Rapoport notes doubtful on Friday report vs LAC. Michael Mayer next man up.
items.why: Injury report listing; confirmed doubtful by team/Rapoport.
items.implication: Sit Bowers; Mayer becomes low-end TE streamer/handcuff with route opportunity.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer snap/route share expansion if Bowers inactive.

items.text: Puka Nacua will not practice Saturday (hip) and is questionable for MNF vs Giants; different injury from camp psoas. Backup Whittington also doubtful.
items.why: Hip/groin; missed second straight practice; McVay confirmation.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; if out, heavier TE (Ferguson/Parkinson) and Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields bump.
items.opportunity: TE usage and secondary WR snaps/routes if inactive.

items.text: Joe Burrow good to go for Sunday vs Texans (from Q on ETR, said he's playing); DE Stewart set for Bengals debut.
items.why: Insiders report good to go; self-reported playing.
items.implication: Start Burrow confidently; CIN offense full strength vs HOU (Collins out).
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets for Chase/Higgins/Brown in standard script.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest Q on the slate; practiced Friday and listed Q. Affects Herbert projections heavily; 4pm ET start allows monitoring.
items.why: Rib injury; biggest slate impact per Levitan; practiced but status uncertain.
items.implication: Monitor closely; if out, Quentin Johnston and LAC WR hierarchy upgrade; Herbert ceiling drops.
items.opportunity: Johnston target share expansion; overall LAC pass game redistribution.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN and ready for 2026 debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown on IR. Potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson; strong upcoming schedule.
items.why: Cleared/IN per ETR; 'ready to go' comments; NE needs explosives post-Brown IR.
items.implication: Henderson flex/RB2 upside in debut; monitor split with Stevenson for carries/routes.
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential; goal-line/third-down mixed with Stevenson; schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF etc) boosts ROS.
items.conflict: Unclear exact split vs Stevenson early-down work.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps) through 3Q Week 1, 40% routes targeted (team lead), 24% tgt share. IND just gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite utilization and receiving role in first KC game; smash matchup.
items.implication: Must-start RB1/RB2 with RB1 overall upside range if healthy.
items.opportunity: High snap, target, carry, red-zone share sustained.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey getting usage bump off Week 1 regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) Q status matters for SF RB share.
items.why: Week 1 usage trends support bump; Black Q could consolidate further.
items.implication: CMC remains elite RB1; Black absence increases snap/carry monopoly.
items.opportunity: Higher snap share, routes, red-zone if Black limited/out.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan lead), 19% tgt share last 10 games, 25+ touches in 3/4 recent. Soft LAC matchup.
items.why: Near-max utilization and receiving involvement under Kubiak; volume locked in.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start with upside; prior injury scare overrated.
items.opportunity: Sustained high touch/target share, three-down role.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: RB9 util Week 1, 26% tgt share (career high), all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Passing-game and RZ monopoly confirmed; favorable matchup.
items.implication: RB2/flex with receiving upside; start over many committee backs.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, goal-line work expansion vs CLE.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE: Matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; NO underdog script bad for rushes.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara IN and Miller; negative game script vs BAL.
items.implication: Sit/fade Etienne; prefer other options in flex.
items.opportunity: Reduced carries/targets as Kamara reclaims third-down/receiving.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% tgt share from Wentz Week 1; 93 rec yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career games with Wentz. CHI soft vs WRs (10+ YPT allowed).
items.why: Volume locked with Wentz starting (Murray OUT); elite historical chemistry and matchup.
items.implication: WR1 lock; high floor/ceiling in PPR.
items.opportunity: Sustained high target share and aDOT vs CHI.
